{{Top}}
[[File:Zikzikzik.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[Hedji]], a Spiner, firing quills from his arm.]]
'''Quills''' were sharp spines that could be produced by various species, including the humanoid [[Spiner]]s<ref name="Starhoppers">{{GamerCite|4|The Starhoppers of Aduba-3}}</ref> and the [[Octopus/Legends|octopus]]-like [[Twenchok/Legends|twenchok]].<ref name="BftGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref> Spiners could produce them rapidly, and suitably trained members of the species could fling them at opponents several times per day.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Twenchok could similarly fire their quills as a defense mechanism, discharging them singly or in volleys.<ref name="BftGS" />

[[Vagh Rodiek]], warbeasts [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] from [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], replaced the head spines characteristic of Rodians with quills.<ref name="IYV">{{GamerCite|8|I, Yuuzhan Vong}}</ref>
